args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337, a high-severity
unbounded-recursion issue when parsing deeply nested arrays.
2.9.4 is the fixed release in the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Security
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The fix is available in 2.9.4 (the patched release in the 2.x line; 3.1.0 also fixes it but is a major-version bump).

The upgrade stays within the 2.x series to minimize risk of breaking changes.

## CI
CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `c8b8ab7878`.
